decisions.reason: The existing message-21 INTRODUCE already establishes the separate Small Block and Big Block counters and their respective post-draw resets; no additional propagation is required.

The existing message-21 MODIFY already records the Small Block pool target, eligibility window, ticket reset, and continued secondary-sale funding; referral-mint ticket quantities remain owned by the source Requirement.
The client explicitly says the no-referral random-ticket allocation remains unchanged, and its existing message-21 Event already represents that behavior.

The existing message-21 MODIFY already records the Big Block trigger, eligibility window, ticket reset, and continued royalty funding; referral-mint ticket quantities remain owned by the source Requirement.
The existing message-21 MODIFY already limits each draw's eligible population to the corresponding tickets issued after the previous draw of that block type.
The existing message-21 INTRODUCE already captures visibility of the two independent ticket counters and permanent badges, so no additional metadata change is needed.
The source explicitly states that the automatic $5 commission remains unchanged, and the candidate already records that rule.

The source confirms that secondary royalties continue; the new prohibition on generating tickets from secondary sales belongs to the source ticket-issuance Requirement and does not alter royalty enforcement.
The source explicitly states that manual claim remains unchanged, and the candidate already records manual prize collection.
The ticket-issuance mechanics do not change the current or planned product branding.
